request: r6.9 — Prefer king opposition with the bishop between the kings.
implementation: After White moves, prefer kings two squares apart on one rank or file with the bishop on the intervening square. Establishing it with a bishop move or retaining it with a knight move also qualifies. Earlier priorities remain ahead of r6.9, which precedes r7.
